method: Japanese quick start guide for the A1376 (file Battery_A1376_QSG_WEB_20240514-JP), linked from Anker's service page as the PowerCore+ 26800 PD 45W 取扱説明書 (A1376), gives the battery capacity, PD input and output ratings, and a green LED in low-current mode.

comps.spec: PD input 5V 3A, 9V 3A, 15V 3A, 20V 2.25A; PD output 5V 3A, 9V 3A, 15V 3A, 20V 2.25A (product spec table).
Product spec table lists PD input, standard output 5V 3A (2.4A max per port) and PD output.
LED light turns green when low-current mode is entered (press the power button twice, or hold it for 2 seconds). A further press of the power button exits the mode.

sources.title: Anker A1376 quick start guide, Japanese (file Battery_A1376_QSG_WEB_20240514-JP): product spec table and LED instructions
